appbar.title: Pixiv Downloader
settings.title: Settings
settings.lang.label: Display language
settings.note.account: Account info used to log in to Pixiv.
settings.note.connection: Proxy and browser identity used for requests.
settings.note.source: Choose which artworks to fetch and how query and download are merged.
settings.note.download: Download location and subfolders auto-created by artwork type.
settings.note.filename: Download filename rules and the timestamp origin.
settings.note.tags: Clean up tags in filenames, and how to handle artworks missing a tag or publish time.
settings.note.filter: Decide which artworks to download by likes, tags and similar conditions.
settings.note.advanced: JXL conversion, request cooldown and scheduled runs.
settings.note.folder_classify: When on, subfolders are created under the download directory by artwork type.
settings.note.filename_template:
Placeholders: {pid} {page} {ext} {tag} {hashtag} {timetag} {date} {time}
Leave empty to use the default rule. Characters Windows disallows are stripped automatically.
settings.note.timestamp: The timestamp origin feeds the {timetag} filename and file time; each download advances it by 1s and writes it back. Falls back to 1970-01-01 on a bad format.
settings.note.source_modes: "Following" fetches the artist list first; "My bookmarks" scans the artwork PIDs you liked in step 2.
settings.ua.hint: Not set; a built-in random UA will be used
settings.ua.detected: Detected Chrome {version} from the registry; UA updated
settings.ua.not_found: Chrome install not found (checked registry and AppData); please enter the UA manually
settings.proxy.label: Proxy list (one per line)
settings.proxy.hint:
# one proxy per line
http://1.2.3.4:8080
socks5://user:pass@host:1080
settings.dir.ai: Separate folder for AI-generated works (off = download to the normal path)
settings.filename.download_time_tooltip: Timestamp origin used for download filenames and file times. Advances by 1s per download and writes back to this field.
settings.filename.set_mtime: Set file time to the timestamp (mtime)
settings.filename.set_mtime_tooltip: Set the downloaded file's modified time to match the timestamp in its name
settings.tags.strip_brackets_tooltip: When on, paired brackets (incl. () （） [] 【】 《》 〈〉 「」 『』 〔〕 〘〙) and their content are removed from filenames
settings.tags.strip_special: Strip decorative symbols and emoji from tags
settings.tags.strip_special_tooltip: When on, arrows, ★☆♀♂♪♫, ◯●◎, emoji and other decorative symbols are removed from tags
settings.tags.notime: Skip artworks without a publish time
settings.filter.rescrape_days_tooltip: When an artwork is newer than this many days, step 3 re-fetches its meta to update likes, so new works aren't filtered out forever by a low initial like count. 0 disables it. Already-downloaded works are never re-fetched.
settings.source.combined_tooltip: When on, step 3 queries each PID and immediately downloads that PID's pages (query and download share one account cooldown); it also absorbs unfinished downloads from the last run.
settings.source.workers_tooltip: How many PIDs to process at once during download-as-found. 1 = sequential (zero regression). Actual concurrency is capped by the number of valid cookies and pending work (each worker uses its own cookie/proxy), max 16. With multiple cookies, raising this speeds things up proportionally.
settings.source.author_order: Download grouped by author (same author consecutively)
settings.source.author_order_tooltip: When on, step 4 downloads all of one author's works consecutively (PID descending) before moving to the next; works with an unknown author go last.
settings.source.force_rescan: Ignore the 30-day skip rule on the next scan (one-time)
settings.source.force_rescan_tooltip: When on, the next step 2 ignores the "scanned within 30 days" skip and re-scans all authors, backfilling every author's full user_id list (for author grouping). Auto-disables after step 2 runs.
settings.adv.intra_wait: Wait between pages of one PID (seconds)
settings.adv.single_thread: Process artworks in a single thread
settings.cooldown.hint_many: {n} cookies: one per account every {avg:.0f}s, ~{throughput:.1f}s per request overall; recommend >= 30s
settings.cooldown_warn.title: Cooldown is short
settings.cooldown_warn.body:
Average cooldown {avg}s is below the recommended 30s,
which may increase the risk of Pixiv rate-limit detection. Apply anyway?
cookies.title: Cookie management
cookies.enable_tooltip: When off, this cookie isn't used for this run
main.page.label: PID {pid} pages
main.source.tooltip.following: Standard flow: fetch following artists, then scan their artwork PIDs.
main.source.tooltip.bookmarks: Step 2 scans the artwork PIDs you liked; the later URL/download steps are unchanged.
stats.title: Statistics
stats.chart.title: Requests per cookie
app.recover_notice: Detected an unclean shutdown last time; auto-recovered {n} events
